evidence: A commenter recommends the HOT update section, followed by zHeap and TOAST notes, to develop a mental model of PostgreSQL.

evidence_sources.author: gopalv
evidence_sources.excerpt: If you are just skimming this doc, The HoT update path is the section I would jump to. Understand HoT and then read the zHeap implementation notes (also of TOAST) puts a good mental model of what postgres does and what it doesn't do.
